title: MasterDataTable (generic table)
scope: Generic table component over row type T. Props: rows, columns ({key,label}[]), rowKey, isActive, onEdit, onToggleActive. Renders shadcn Table with header from columns, body rows, and an Actions column (Edit + Activate/Deactivate). Inactive rows render with muted style.

success_criteria.manual: Render with seed rows; click Edit -> calls onEdit(row); click Deactivate -> calls onToggleActive(row).
success_criteria.automated: TC-040 verifies muted-row rendering and api call on Deactivate.
success_criteria.definition_of_done: Generic over T; inactive rows visually muted; Actions column always last.

checkout_prompt: 'MasterDataTable — generic table with Edit + Activate/Deactivate actions.'
